title: 單元式帷幕牆安裝~Unitized curtain-wall installation
focus: 以錨定反力、上下單元接縫變位、豎框勁度與安裝公差控制，讓工廠組裝的單元板塊在高層主結構上可靠就位~Anchor reactions, stack-joint movement, mullion stiffness and installation tolerance control that seat factory-built units reliably on a tall structure
summary: 從單元板塊的風壓與自重傳遞路徑出發，計算錨件反力、樓板撓度與層間變位對上下單元接縫的需求，說明公母豎框、預埋槽與三向調整錨件的設計，再處理樓層吊運、安裝順序、公差吸收與性能樣品牆的層間位移試驗，最後以斷熱、排水、結露與維護更換完成交接，並以哈里發塔、世界貿易中心一號大樓與碎片大廈的公開資料說明超高層立面的尺度。~Starting from how wind and self-weight travel through a unit, calculate anchor reactions and the demands that slab deflection and interstorey drift place on the stack joint, explain split mullions, cast-in channels and three-way adjustable brackets, then cover floor-by-floor logistics, installation sequence, tolerance absorption and racking tests on the performance mock-up, and close with thermal breaks, drainage, condensation and maintenance, using public information on Burj Khalifa, One World Trade Center and The Shard to show the scale of supertall façades.

units.anchor: 樓板邊緣錨件反力~Slab-edge anchor reaction
units.title: 單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力~Unit load path and anchor reactions
units.mechanism: 單元式帷幕牆把玻璃、鋁框、層間板與密封在工廠組成一層樓高、一個模數寬的板塊，現場只需掛上錨件並與相鄰單元插接。風壓由玻璃傳到豎框，豎框像跨越一層樓的簡支梁，上端反力經錨件進入樓板邊緣，下端反力經上下單元接縫傳給下一個單元的頂部，再由同一組錨件承受。自重則由每層錨件直接吊掛，並因板塊外移於樓板邊緣而產生偏心彎矩。設計時必須把每一層錨件的水平與垂直反力交給主結構設計者，納入樓板邊緣與邊梁的設計。~A unitized curtain wall assembles glass, aluminium framing, spandrel panels and seals in the factory into panels one storey high and one module wide, so on site each unit only needs to be hooked onto its anchors and interlocked with its neighbours. Wind passes from the glass to the mullions, which act as simple beams spanning one storey: the top reaction goes through the anchor into the slab edge, while the bottom reaction passes through the stack joint into the head of the unit below and on to the same anchors. Self-weight hangs directly from each floor's anchors and, because the unit sits outboard of the slab edge, creates an eccentric moment. Each floor's horizontal and vertical anchor reactions must be handed to the structural engineer for the design of the slab edge and edge beams.
units.model: 單元 1.5 m × 4.2 m、設計風壓 q = 3.0 kPa：每單元風力 = 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN，每層兩個錨件各約 9.45 kN。單元面重 50 kg/m²，重 1.5×4.2×50 = 315 kg ≈ 3.09 kN；偏心 150 mm 時彎矩 ≈ 3.09×0.15 ≈ 0.46 kN·m。數值為教學假設。~For a 1.5 m × 4.2 m unit at design pressure q = 3.0 kPa, the wind on each unit is 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN, about 9.45 kN at each of the two anchors per floor. At 50 kg/m² the unit weighs 1.5×4.2×50 = 315 kg ≈ 3.09 kN; with 150 mm eccentricity the moment is about 3.09×0.15 ≈ 0.46 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以帷幕牆結構計算書列出各區（一般區、角隅區、頂部）的設計風壓、單元尺寸與錨件反力表，並由主結構設計者書面確認樓板邊緣、邊梁與預埋件能承受；風壓應以風洞試驗或規範的局部外壓係數為依據，角隅區通常明顯較高。~List in the façade structural calculations the design pressure, unit size and anchor reactions for each zone (typical, corner, top), and have the structural engineer confirm in writing that slab edges, edge beams and embeds can take them; pressures should come from wind-tunnel testing or code local cladding coefficients, and corner zones are usually much higher.
units.failure: 若只用一般區風壓設計全部錨件，角隅區單元在颱風中可能拉脫錨件或使豎框過度變形；未把偏心自重交給結構設計者，懸臂樓板邊緣長期下垂，上下單元接縫被擠壓而漏水。~Designing all anchors for the typical-zone pressure lets corner units pull out their anchors or over-deflect their mullions in a typhoon; if the eccentric dead load is never passed to the structural engineer, cantilevered slab edges sag over time and squeeze the stack joints until they leak.
units.misconception: 帷幕牆只是外裝飾，它的荷重對主結構可以忽略。~A curtain wall is just cladding, so its loads on the main structure can be ignored.
units.practice: 介面協調時以「錨件反力表」作為正式交付文件，標明荷重組合、作用點與偏心，並約定任何單元尺寸或風壓分區變更都要重新發出反力表，由結構設計者確認後才可施作預埋件。~Make the anchor-reaction table a formal deliverable at interface coordination, stating load combinations, points of application and eccentricities, and agree that any change of unit size or wind zone triggers a reissued table, confirmed by the structural engineer before embeds are cast.

units.title: 層間變位、樓板撓度與上下單元接縫~Interstorey drift, slab deflection and the stack joint
units.mechanism: 每一層的單元在水平接縫處以公母型材互相插接，形成「上下單元接縫」。它必須同時做到防水、氣密與允許變位：樓板在活載重下撓曲、柱與核心筒長期縮短、鋁框隨溫度伸縮，都使上下單元的間距改變；地震或強風造成的層間變位則讓上下樓層水平錯動。單元式系統的優勢在於每個單元可在接縫處滑動或轉動，而不是讓玻璃本身受剪；但接縫的伸縮量若估計不足，密封條會被擠出或拉開。~Units at each floor interlock at the horizontal joint through male and female profiles, forming the stack joint. It must be watertight and airtight while allowing movement: slab deflection under live load, long-term shortening of columns and core, and thermal movement of the aluminium all change the gap between units, and interstorey drift from earthquakes or strong wind shifts one floor sideways relative to the next. The advantage of a unitized system is that each unit can slide or rotate at the joints instead of shearing the glass; but if the joint's movement range is underestimated, the seals are squeezed out or pulled apart.
units.model: 垂直變位預算：樓板邊緣差異撓度 10 mm＋鋁豎框溫度伸縮 ΔL = 23×10⁻⁶×4,200×60 ≈ 5.8 mm＋柱與核心差異縮短 3 mm ≈ 18.8 mm，接縫設計行程取 ±20 mm。水平層間變位 H/400 = 4,200/400 = 10.5 mm，由單元在接縫處側向滑動吸收。數值為教學假設。~Vertical movement budget: differential slab-edge deflection 10 mm + aluminium mullion thermal movement ΔL = 23×10⁻⁶×4,200×60 ≈ 5.8 mm + differential shortening of columns and core 3 mm ≈ 18.8 mm, so the joint is designed for ±20 mm. Horizontal interstorey drift H/400 = 4,200/400 = 10.5 mm is absorbed by units sliding sideways at the joints. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 向結構設計者取得各層樓板邊緣撓度、施工後長期縮短與設計層間變位的數值，逐項加總為變位預算；以性能樣品牆的層間位移試驗確認接縫在設計位移下不脫開、不漏水，並在安裝紀錄中量測每條接縫的初始間隙是否位於設計值中央。~Obtain from the structural engineer each floor's slab-edge deflection, post-installation long-term shortening and design drift, and add them into a movement budget; confirm by racking tests on the performance mock-up that the joint neither disengages nor leaks at design movement, and record each joint's initial gap at installation to check that it sits near the middle of its range.
units.failure: 未計入核心筒長期縮短的超高層，在完工數年後上下單元接縫逐漸閉合，密封條被擠出、玻璃角隅受壓破裂；初始間隙安裝在行程一端的接縫，第一次大位移就被拉開而漏水。~In a supertall tower that ignored long-term core shortening, stack joints gradually close in the years after completion, squeezing out seals and cracking glass corners; joints installed at one end of their range are pulled open by the first large movement and leak.
units.misconception: 只要密封膠夠好，上下單元接縫不需要預留變位行程。~With good enough sealant, the stack joint needs no allowance for movement.
units.practice: 變位預算表應列為帷幕牆與結構雙方簽認的介面文件；安裝時每層抽量接縫初始間隙，偏離中心超過預定值即停止並調整錨件高度，避免把誤差累積到上方樓層。~The movement budget should be an interface document signed by both the façade and structural teams; during installation spot-check each floor's initial joint gaps and stop to adjust anchor heights if any deviates from centre by more than the agreed amount, so errors are not carried up the building.

units.anchor: 公母豎框鋁擠型~Split male–female mullions
units.title: 公母豎框斷面與撓度控制~Split-mullion sections and deflection control
units.mechanism: 單元式帷幕牆的豎框由相鄰兩個單元各自的半支豎框（公框與母框）插接而成，兩半之間有密封條與間隙，使單元能獨立安裝與更換。風壓下兩半支豎框各自承擔一部分彎矩，若插接處沒有可靠的共同作用，應以兩者慣性矩相加、而非組合斷面來計算。鋁的彈性模數約為鋼的三分之一，因此豎框斷面通常由撓度而非強度控制；撓度過大會使玻璃邊緣轉動、密封條受拉，並讓室內人員感受到牆面「鼓動」。~The mullion of a unitized wall is formed by two half-mullions, male and female, one from each adjacent unit, interlocked with gaskets and a gap so that units can be installed and replaced independently. Under wind each half carries part of the moment, and unless the interlock reliably acts compositely, the stiffness should be taken as the sum of the two inertias rather than a combined section. Aluminium has about one third of the stiffness of steel, so mullion sections are usually governed by deflection rather than strength; excessive deflection rotates glass edges, stretches gaskets and lets occupants feel the wall pumping.
units.model: 豎框分擔寬度 1.5 m、q = 3.0 kPa，w = 4.5 kN/m；跨度 4.2 m，M = wL²/8 = 4.5×4.2²/8 ≈ 9.92 kN·m。撓度限制 L/175 = 24 mm，所需公母框合計慣性矩 I ≥ 5wL⁴/(384E·δ) = 5×4.5×4,200⁴/(384×70,000×24) ≈ 1.09×10⁷ mm⁴（約 1,085 cm⁴）。數值為教學假設。~With a tributary width of 1.5 m and q = 3.0 kPa, w = 4.5 kN/m; over a 4.2 m span M = wL²/8 = 4.5×4.2²/8 ≈ 9.92 kN·m. With a deflection limit of L/175 = 24 mm, the combined male and female inertia must be I ≥ 5wL⁴/(384E·δ) = 5×4.5×4,200⁴/(384×70,000×24) ≈ 1.09×10⁷ mm⁴ (about 1,085 cm⁴). Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以鋁擠型的實際斷面性質（扣除斷熱條的貢獻或依試驗取用組合效應）計算撓度與應力，檢查鋁合金回火等級的容許應力；性能樣品牆的結構試驗中在豎框中央設位移計，比較設計風壓下的實測撓度與計算值。~Compute deflection and stress from the actual extrusion properties, excluding the thermal-break contribution unless composite action is proven by test, and check the allowable stress for the alloy temper; in the mock-up structural test place displacement gauges at mullion mid-span and compare measured deflection at design pressure with the calculation.
units.failure: 把公母框當成完整組合斷面計算，實際插接處滑動使勁度只剩部分，強風時豎框撓度超過限制，玻璃邊緣密封被拉開而漏水；角隅區豎框未加強，在颱風中永久變形。~Treating the male and female halves as a fully composite section lets the interlock slip so only part of the stiffness acts; in strong wind mullion deflection exceeds the limit and glass-edge seals open and leak, while unreinforced corner-zone mullions deform permanently in a typhoon.
units.misconception: 鋁豎框只要應力低於容許值，撓度就不必另外檢查。~If an aluminium mullion's stress is below the allowable value, its deflection need not be checked.
units.practice: 對風壓較高的角隅與頂部區，事先準備鋼補強或較深的豎框型材，並在模具開發前完成計算；豎框模具一旦開出，斷面難以更改，因此擠型圖須經帷幕牆顧問與結構設計者核可後才可開模。~Prepare steel reinforcement or deeper mullion profiles for high-pressure corner and top zones and finish the calculations before die development; once dies are cut the section is hard to change, so extrusion drawings must be approved by the façade consultant and structural engineer before tooling.

units.anchor: 預埋槽與三向調整錨件~Cast-in channel and three-way bracket
units.title: 預埋槽、錨件與異種金屬隔離~Cast-in channels, brackets and dissimilar-metal isolation
units.mechanism: 單元板塊透過樓板邊緣的錨件就位。錨件通常由預埋在混凝土內的錨定槽、可調的鋼或鋁托架與單元頂部的掛鉤組成，提供進出、左右與上下三個方向的調整，以吸收樓板邊緣位置的施工誤差。預埋槽必須在澆置混凝土前精準定位，邊距、間距與鋼筋衝突都會降低拉拔承載。鋁與鋼接觸時，在潮濕環境下會產生電位腐蝕，因此要以絕緣墊片、塗層或不鏽鋼螺栓隔離。哈里發塔的 CTBUH 資料亦列出預埋槽與錨固系統供應商，說明這類元件在超高層立面的關鍵地位。~Units are seated on brackets at the slab edge. A bracket typically consists of an anchor channel cast into the concrete, an adjustable steel or aluminium bracket and the hook at the head of the unit, providing in–out, left–right and up–down adjustment to absorb construction errors in slab-edge position. The channel must be set accurately before the concrete pour, since edge distance, spacing and clashes with reinforcement all reduce pull-out capacity. Aluminium in contact with steel in damp conditions suffers galvanic corrosion, so isolating pads, coatings or stainless fasteners are used. The CTBUH record for Burj Khalifa lists anchor-channel and fixing suppliers, showing how central these components are to supertall façades.
units.model: 風吸時每錨件拉力 9.45 kN，乘荷重係數 1.5 為 14.2 kN；自重偏心彎矩 0.46 kN·m 若由兩個錨件的螺栓以 80 mm 力臂抵抗，每錨件附加拉力約 0.46/0.08/2 ≈ 2.9 kN，合計約 17.1 kN，須小於預埋槽在該邊距下的設計拉拔承載。數值為教學假設。~Under suction each anchor carries 9.45 kN, or 14.2 kN with a 1.5 load factor; if the 0.46 kN·m dead-load eccentric moment is resisted by the bolts of two anchors with an 80 mm lever arm, each anchor gains about 0.46/0.08/2 ≈ 2.9 kN, for a total of about 17.1 kN, which must be below the channel's design pull-out capacity at that edge distance. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 澆置前由測量員依控制網放樣檢查每支預埋槽的位置、高程與方向，並與鋼筋綁紮比對；澆置後抽樣做現場拉拔試驗確認承載；錨件安裝時檢查絕緣墊片、螺栓材質與防鬆措施，並拍照紀錄每一層的完成狀態。~Before the pour have surveyors check each channel's position, level and orientation from the control network and against the reinforcement; after the pour carry out sample pull-out tests to confirm capacity; at bracket installation check isolating pads, bolt material and locking measures, and photograph each floor's completed condition.
units.failure: 預埋槽被振動棒擠歪或與鋼筋衝突而被移位，邊距不足造成混凝土錐體拉破；若漏裝絕緣墊片，沿海高樓數年後鋁托架與鋼件接觸處腐蝕，錨件鬆動而單元下沉。~Channels pushed askew by vibrators or displaced by clashes with reinforcement end up with too little edge distance and fail by concrete cone breakout; if isolating pads are omitted, a coastal tower sees aluminium brackets corrode at steel contacts within a few years, loosening anchors and letting units drop.
units.misconception: 錨件的調整範圍越大越好，可以吸收任何樓板誤差。~The bigger the bracket adjustment range, the better, since it can absorb any slab error.
units.practice: 預埋件放樣與檢查應列為混凝土澆置前的停止點，由帷幕牆廠商與結構監造共同簽認；遺漏或偏位的預埋槽只能以經設計核可的後置錨栓替代，並須做拉拔試驗。~Make embed setting-out and inspection a hold point before each pour, signed jointly by the façade contractor and the structural supervisor; missing or misplaced channels may be replaced only by design-approved post-installed anchors, with pull-out tests.

units.anchor: 樓層吊運與安裝節奏~Floor logistics and installation rate
units.title: 工廠組裝、樓層吊運與安裝節奏~Factory assembly, floor logistics and installation rate
units.mechanism: 單元式系統把大部分工作移到工廠：玻璃安裝、結構矽利康固化、密封與品質檢查都在可控環境完成，現場只剩吊運、掛接與接縫密封。施工時單元以工地升降機或塔吊送到樓層暫存，再以樓上的單軌吊車、小型吊機或專用安裝機從外側掛上錨件，通常由下往上、緊跟在主結構之後數層進行。安裝高度越高，風速越大、可作業時間越短；哈里發塔官方資料即記錄其鋁與玻璃立面在 512 m 高度安裝，創下當時紀錄。~A unitized system moves most work into the factory: glazing, structural silicone curing, sealing and quality checks happen in controlled conditions, leaving only hoisting, hooking on and joint sealing for site. Units travel by hoist or tower crane to temporary storage on each floor, then a monorail, mini-crane or dedicated installer on the floor above lowers them onto their anchors from outside, usually working upward a few floors behind the structure. The higher the installation, the stronger the wind and the shorter the working window; Burj Khalifa's official information records the installation of its aluminium and glass façade at a height of 512 m as a record.
units.model: 標準層周長 120 m、單元寬 1.5 m，每層 120/1.5 = 80 片；60 層共 4,800 片。若一組安裝隊每日 40 片，需 4,800/40 = 120 個工作天，每週 6 天約 20 週；若高空風速限制使有效工作日減少 25%，約需 160 個工作天。數值為教學假設。~A typical floor with a 120 m perimeter and 1.5 m units needs 120/1.5 = 80 units; 60 floors need 4,800. At 40 units per day for one crew, that is 4,800/40 = 120 working days, about 20 weeks at 6 days per week; if wind limits at height cut effective working days by 25%, about 160 working days are needed. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每片單元出廠前有逐片檢查表（玻璃、矽利康、密封條、排水孔、編號），進場時再檢查運輸損傷；安裝前確認樓層暫存荷重不超過樓板允許值、吊具與單軌吊車經檢驗、風速計讀值在吊裝上限內，並由起重負責人核准當日吊裝。~Each unit leaves the factory with a unit-by-unit checklist covering glass, silicone, gaskets, drainage holes and ID, and is checked again for transport damage on arrival; before installation confirm that floor storage loads are within slab capacity, that lifting gear and monorails are inspected and that the anemometer reading is within the lifting limit, with the lifting supervisor approving each day's lifts.
units.failure: 樓層暫存單元過度集中造成樓板局部超載；安裝進度與主結構相距太近，上方仍在澆置混凝土時下方單元被汙染或撞擊。單元編號錯置使不同風壓區的單元互換，角隅區裝上一般區的單元，在颱風中變形或漏水。~Concentrating stored units on one bay overloads the slab locally; installing too close behind the structure lets concrete work above soil or strike new units below. Mixed-up unit IDs swap units between pressure zones, so a typical-zone unit ends up at a corner and deforms or leaks in a typhoon.
units.misconception: 單元式帷幕牆在工廠完成，現場安裝不需要品質管制。~Because units are made in the factory, site installation needs no quality control.
units.practice: 以 BIM 或條碼系統管理每片單元的編號、風壓區、出廠檢查與安裝位置；吊裝屬高風險作業，每日開工前確認風速、吊具與禁區，由起重負責人與帷幕牆工地主任簽認後才開始。~Manage each unit's ID, pressure zone, factory checks and installed position with BIM or barcodes; lifting is high-risk work, so every day confirm wind speed, lifting gear and exclusion zones, with the lifting supervisor and façade site manager signing before work starts.

units.anchor: 安裝公差預算~Installation tolerance budget
units.title: 現場測量與公差吸收~Site survey and tolerance absorption
units.mechanism: 混凝土主結構的樓板邊緣位置誤差常以數十毫米計，而帷幕牆單元之間的接縫只容許數毫米的偏差；兩者的落差必須由錨件調整量吸收。安裝前測量人員要依施工控制網量測每層樓板邊緣與預埋件的實際位置，帷幕牆廠商據此決定每個錨件的調整值，必要時調整特殊單元或錨件。各項誤差並非同時達到最大值，常以平方和開根號估算組合誤差，但若某一項系統性偏移（例如整棟樓扭轉）就不能用此方法。~Slab-edge positions in a concrete structure deviate by tens of millimetres, while joints between curtain-wall units tolerate only a few millimetres; the difference must be absorbed by bracket adjustment. Before installation surveyors measure each floor's actual slab-edge and embed positions from the construction control network, and the façade contractor sets each bracket's adjustment from these, modifying special units or brackets where needed. Individual errors rarely peak together, so the combination is often estimated by the root sum of squares, but this method fails if one error is systematic, such as a twist of the whole building.
units.model: 組合誤差 e = √(e₁² + e₂² + e₃²)。樓板邊緣 ±25 mm、預埋槽位置 ±10 mm、托架製作 ±5 mm：e = √(25² + 10² + 5²) = √750 ≈ 27.4 mm < 錨件進出調整量 ±30 mm；若樓板誤差增為 ±30 mm，e ≈ 31.8 mm，已超過調整量。數值為教學假設。~Combined error e = √(e₁² + e₂² + e₃²). With slab edge ±25 mm, channel position ±10 mm and bracket fabrication ±5 mm: e = √(25² + 10² + 5²) = √750 ≈ 27.4 mm, within an in–out bracket adjustment of ±30 mm; if the slab error grows to ±30 mm, e ≈ 31.8 mm, beyond the adjustment. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每層以全站儀量測樓板邊緣與預埋件座標，製作偏差圖並交帷幕牆廠商；安裝後量測單元的垂直度、平整度、接縫寬度與相鄰單元面差，記錄於逐層檢查表，與規範允收值（例如每層與累積的垂直度限值）比較，超出時由帷幕牆工程師判定調整方式。~Survey slab-edge and embed coordinates on each floor with a total station, prepare deviation maps and pass them to the façade contractor; after installation measure plumb, flatness, joint widths and steps between adjacent units on a floor-by-floor checklist against specified limits, such as per-floor and cumulative plumb, with the façade engineer deciding how to correct exceedances.
units.failure: 未事先量測樓板邊緣就開始安裝，到中途才發現某些樓層偏差超過錨件調整量，只好現場改造托架或切割單元，破壞防水與防蝕；以每層各自對齊而非對準控制線，垂直誤差逐層累積，高處立面明顯歪斜。~Starting installation without surveying the slab edges reveals midway that some floors exceed the bracket range, forcing site modification of brackets or cutting of units that damages waterproofing and corrosion protection; aligning each floor to the one below instead of to control lines lets plumb errors accumulate until the upper façade visibly leans.
units.misconception: 只要每一片單元都對齊下面那一片，整面帷幕牆就一定垂直。~If each unit lines up with the one below it, the whole wall is bound to be plumb.
units.practice: 測量控制線由主結構控制網引出並定期複測，帷幕牆每隔數層以控制線重新歸零，不得逐層累積；樓板偏差超過錨件調整量時，須先由結構與帷幕牆雙方會勘決定處理方式，再繼續安裝。~Derive façade control lines from the main structure's control network and re-survey them regularly, resetting the façade to the lines every few floors rather than accumulating errors; where slab deviation exceeds bracket adjustment, both structural and façade teams must inspect and agree the remedy before installation continues.

units.anchor: 性能樣品牆層間位移試驗~Mock-up racking test
units.title: 性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗~Performance mock-up and racking test
units.mechanism: 量產前，帷幕牆廠商會在試驗室以實尺寸、至少兩層樓高的性能樣品牆，依序進行氣密、水密、結構與層間位移等試驗。對單元式系統而言，最關鍵的往往是層間位移試驗：試驗架把上下樓層的模擬樓板相對水平推移，檢查上下單元接縫與公母豎框能否滑動而不脫開、玻璃不破、密封不失效，並在位移後重做水密試驗。樣品牆應包含角隅、上下單元接縫與典型錨件，才能代表真實立面。~Before production the façade contractor tests a full-size performance mock-up, at least two storeys high, in a laboratory in sequence for air, water, structural and racking performance. For unitized systems the racking test is often the most critical: the rig moves the simulated floors above and below horizontally relative to each other to check that stack joints and split mullions slide without disengaging, glass does not break and seals keep working, with the water test repeated after the movement. The mock-up must include a corner, stack joints and typical anchors to represent the real façade.
units.model: 設計層間變位角 0.5%，層高 4.2 m：Δ = 0.005×4,200 = 21 mm；試驗取 1.5 倍為 31.5 mm。若接縫插接深度 40 mm、單元寬 1.5 m 在 31.5 mm 位移下的轉角 θ ≈ 31.5/4,200 ≈ 0.0075 rad，插接處水平滑移需求約 31.5 mm，仍小於 40 mm。數值為教學假設。~For a design drift ratio of 0.5% and a 4.2 m storey, Δ = 0.005×4,200 = 21 mm; the test uses 1.5 times, 31.5 mm. With a 40 mm interlock and 1.5 m units, the rotation at 31.5 mm is θ ≈ 31.5/4,200 ≈ 0.0075 rad and the sliding demand at the interlock is about 31.5 mm, still below 40 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗計畫依 AAMA 501.4 或專案規範訂定位移值、循環次數與允收準則（無脫落、無玻璃破裂、位移後水密合格、殘餘變形在限值內），並由業主的帷幕牆顧問到場見證；試驗後拆解樣品，檢查錨件、密封條與插接處的磨損。~Set displacement values, cycles and acceptance criteria (no fallout, no glass breakage, water test passed after movement, residual deformation within limits) per AAMA 501.4 or the project specification, witnessed by the owner's façade consultant; after the test dismantle the specimen and inspect anchors, gaskets and interlocks for wear.
units.failure: 樣品牆只做氣密水密而未做層間位移試驗，實際地震後上下單元接縫脫開、密封條移位，下一場颱風就大面積漏水；樣品牆若省略角隅，量產後才發現角隅單元在位移下互相碰撞。~A mock-up tested only for air and water but not for racking leaves stack joints that disengage and gaskets that shift after a real earthquake, so the next typhoon causes widespread leaks; omitting the corner from the mock-up reveals only in production that corner units collide under movement.
units.misconception: 單元式帷幕牆的接縫可以滑動，因此不需要做層間位移試驗。~Because unitized joints can slide, no racking test is needed.
units.practice: 量產開模與大量下料前，以樣品牆試驗合格作為停止點；試驗中為了通過而做的任何修改（加密封、換墊片、改排水）都要回寫到施工圖與製造圖，並由帷幕牆顧問確認已落實到量產單元。~Make a passed mock-up test the hold point before production tooling and bulk cutting; any modification made during testing to pass, such as added sealant, changed gaskets or altered drainage, must be written back into the shop and fabrication drawings and confirmed by the façade consultant in the production units.

units.anchor: 錨件螺栓預壓與紀錄~Anchor bolt preload and records
units.title: 錨件鎖固、防鬆與逐層驗收~Anchor tightening, locking and floor-by-floor acceptance
units.mechanism: 單元掛上錨件並調整到位後，需以螺栓鎖固並設置防鬆與防位移措施（例如鋸齒墊片、止動螺栓或點焊），否則風壓反覆作用與溫度循環會讓調整位置慢慢滑移。部分錨件需要允許單元在接縫方向滑動，部分則必須完全固定，這些「固定點」與「滑動點」的配置錯誤會讓溫度變位推擠相鄰單元。逐層驗收的目的，是在上方樓層封閉施工通道前，確認每個錨件都按設計鎖固、每條接縫都正確插接。~Once a unit is hooked on and adjusted, its bracket must be bolted and locked against slip, for example with serrated washers, stop bolts or tack welds, or repeated wind and thermal cycling will gradually shift the adjusted position. Some brackets must let the unit slide along the joint while others must be fully fixed, and getting this fixed-point and sliding-point arrangement wrong lets thermal movement push neighbouring units. Floor-by-floor acceptance confirms, before access from the floor above is closed off, that every bracket is locked as designed and every joint correctly interlocked.
units.model: 扭力與預壓 T = K·F·d。取扭矩係數 K = 0.2、目標預壓 F = 20 kN、M12 螺栓 d = 0.012 m：T = 0.2×20,000×0.012 = 48 N·m。若螺紋乾燥使 K 升為 0.3，同樣 48 N·m 只得到 F = 48/(0.3×0.012) ≈ 13.3 kN，約為目標的 67%。數值為教學假設。~Torque and preload T = K·F·d. With nut factor K = 0.2, target preload F = 20 kN and an M12 bolt with d = 0.012 m: T = 0.2×20,000×0.012 = 48 N·m. If dry threads raise K to 0.3, the same 48 N·m gives only F = 48/(0.3×0.012) ≈ 13.3 kN, about 67% of the target. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以校正過的扭力扳手鎖固並抽樣複驗，在螺栓與托架上做防鬆標記；逐層檢查表記錄每個錨件的調整值、扭力、防鬆措施、固定或滑動屬性與絕緣墊片，並拍照，由帷幕牆工程師與監造共同簽認後才拆除該層的安裝通道。~Tighten with calibrated torque wrenches and re-check a sample, marking bolts and brackets to show any loosening; the floor checklist records each bracket's adjustment, torque, locking measure, fixed or sliding designation and isolating pad, with photographs, signed jointly by the façade engineer and supervising engineer before that floor's installation access is removed.
units.failure: 趕工時只用手鎖或漏裝止動件，數年後錨件在風壓循環下滑移，單元下沉並把上下接縫擠閉；把應滑動的錨件鎖死，夏季高溫時鋁框伸長無處釋放，造成接縫密封剪壞與異音。~Hand-tightening under time pressure or omitting stops lets brackets slip under cyclic wind over the years, so units drop and close the stack joints; locking a bracket that should slide leaves summer expansion nowhere to go, shearing joint seals and causing creaking.
units.misconception: 錨件螺栓只要鎖緊，扭力值高低並不重要。~As long as bracket bolts are tight, the torque value does not matter.
units.practice: 錨件圖應以符號清楚區分固定點與滑動點，並規定螺栓等級、扭力、潤滑狀態與防鬆方式；逐層錨件驗收是封閉安裝通道前的停止點，未簽認的樓層不得拆除臨時工作平台。~Bracket drawings must clearly mark fixed and sliding points by symbol and state bolt grade, torque, lubrication condition and locking method; floor-by-floor bracket acceptance is a hold point before installation access closes, and temporary work platforms on an unsigned floor may not be removed.

units.anchor: 斷熱條與內表面溫度~Thermal break and inner surface temperature
units.title: 斷熱、等壓排水與結露控制~Thermal breaks, pressure-equalised drainage and condensation
units.mechanism: 單元式帷幕牆的耐久與舒適，取決於三個看不見的系統：鋁框中的斷熱條阻斷熱橋，避免室內側框料過冷結露；外層密封與內層氣密之間的等壓腔體，讓滲入的少量雨水在壓差很小的情況下由排水孔排出；層間板背後的防火與防潮層則避免水汽在牆內凝結。若室內側框料表面溫度低於室內空氣的露點，冬季就會結露、滴水並使框料與密封長期受潮。等壓與排水路徑若被密封膠堵住，原本安全的雨水就會被困在單元內。~The durability and comfort of a unitized wall depend on three hidden systems: polyamide thermal breaks in the aluminium cut thermal bridges so inner frames do not get cold enough to condense; a pressure-equalised cavity between the outer seal and the inner air seal lets the small amount of water that enters drain through weep holes under a very small pressure difference; and fire and vapour layers behind spandrels stop moisture condensing inside the wall. If the inner frame surface falls below the dew point of room air, winter condensation drips and keeps frames and seals wet; if sealant blocks the drainage and equalisation paths, otherwise harmless rain is trapped inside the unit.
units.model: 內表面溫度 T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total。T_i = 21°C、T_o = −5°C、R_si = 0.13 m²K/W、框料 U = 3.0 W/m²K（R_total ≈ 0.333）：T_si = 21 − 26×0.13/0.333 ≈ 10.9°C；室內 21°C、相對濕度 50% 的露點約 10.2°C，餘裕僅約 0.7 K。U 改善為 2.0 時 T_si ≈ 14.2°C。數值為教學假設。~Inner surface temperature T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total. With T_i = 21°C, T_o = −5°C, R_si = 0.13 m²K/W and a frame U = 3.0 W/m²K (R_total ≈ 0.333): T_si = 21 − 26×0.13/0.333 ≈ 10.9°C; the dew point of room air at 21°C and 50% relative humidity is about 10.2°C, a margin of only about 0.7 K. Improving U to 2.0 gives T_si ≈ 14.2°C. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以二維熱傳模擬（如 ISO 10211 方法）計算框料內表面最低溫度與溫度係數，與室內設計溫濕度的露點比較；在樣品牆與現場檢查排水孔是否暢通、等壓腔體是否被多餘密封膠堵塞，必要時以紅外線熱像儀在冬季找出熱橋。~Calculate the minimum inner-frame surface temperature and temperature factor with two-dimensional heat-transfer modelling, for example by ISO 10211 methods, and compare with the dew point of the indoor design condition; on the mock-up and on site check that weep holes are clear and that pressure-equalised cavities are not blocked by excess sealant, and use infrared thermography in winter to find thermal bridges where needed.
units.failure: 為了省成本取消斷熱條或以金屬螺絲穿過斷熱層，寒流時室內框料結露滴水，長期造成內裝發霉與密封膠脫黏；現場補打密封膠堵住排水孔，雨水在單元底部累積，最後從室內側溢出。~Omitting thermal breaks to save cost, or driving metal screws through them, lets inner frames condense and drip in cold spells, causing mould in finishes and debonded seals over time; sealant added on site that blocks weep holes lets rainwater collect in the bottom of units until it spills indoors.
units.misconception: 帷幕牆漏水時，多打一層密封膠把所有縫封死就能解決。~When a curtain wall leaks, sealing every gap with more sealant solves the problem.
units.practice: 施工說明中標示所有不得填塞的排水孔與等壓通道，並禁止現場未經核准的補打密封；維修單位在處理漏水前，須先由帷幕牆顧問判斷水的路徑，而非直接封閉。~Mark on the installation drawings every weep hole and equalisation path that must stay open and prohibit unapproved site sealing; before treating a leak, maintenance staff must have the façade consultant trace the water path instead of simply sealing over it.

units.anchor: 外牆維護吊車與更換紀錄~BMU access and replacement records
units.title: 維護吊車、單元更換與竣工交接~Maintenance access, unit replacement and handover
units.mechanism: 超高層帷幕牆完工後仍需數十年的清洗、檢查、密封更新與玻璃更換，這些都依賴外牆維護吊車（BMU）的軌道、吊臂伸距與固定點。單元式系統的玻璃多以結構矽利康固定在框上，更換時常需從外側以 BMU 吊運新玻璃，或在室內拆下整片單元，因此設計時就要確認 BMU 能到達每一片單元、吊運能力足以處理最大玻璃。CTBUH 資料中哈里發塔另列有外牆維護顧問，顯示超高層維護規劃是獨立的專業。~After completion a supertall curtain wall still needs decades of cleaning, inspection, seal renewal and glass replacement, all depending on the building maintenance unit (BMU) tracks, jib reach and restraint points. In unitized systems glass is often structurally siliconed to the frame, so replacement usually means lifting new glass from outside with the BMU or removing a whole unit from inside, and the design must confirm that the BMU can reach every unit and lift the largest pane. The CTBUH record for Burj Khalifa separately lists a façade-maintenance consultant, showing that supertall maintenance planning is a specialism of its own.
units.model: 立面面積 = 周長 120 m × 60 層 × 4.2 m = 30,240 m²；兩台 BMU 每台每日清洗 600 m²，一輪約 30,240/(2×600) ≈ 25.2 天。若單元年更換率 0.2%，4,800 片每年約 9.6 片，建議常備約 10 片典型尺寸玻璃與密封材。數值為教學假設。~Façade area = 120 m perimeter × 60 floors × 4.2 m = 30,240 m²; with two BMUs cleaning 600 m² per day each, one cycle takes about 30,240/(2×600) ≈ 25.2 days. With an annual replacement rate of 0.2%, 4,800 units need about 9.6 replacements per year, so about 10 typical-size panes and seal kits should be kept in stock. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前以實際操作確認 BMU 能到達最難接近的角隅與退縮處，並以最大玻璃尺寸做吊運演練；定期檢查計畫包含密封膠硬度與附著抽驗、排水孔清理、錨件抽樣檢查與漏水紀錄分析，結果與竣工基準比較。~Before handover demonstrate that the BMU reaches the most difficult corners and setbacks, and rehearse lifting the largest glass size; the periodic inspection plan includes sealant hardness and adhesion sampling, weep-hole cleaning, sample bracket checks and analysis of leak records, compared with the completion baseline.
units.failure: BMU 吊臂伸距不足以到達退縮樓層的立面，某片玻璃破裂後只能搭設昂貴的臨時吊架；交接時沒有留下單元編號與玻璃規格對照，更換時訂錯鍍膜或尺寸，色差與漏水問題接踵而來。~A BMU jib too short to reach façades at setback floors means a single broken pane needs costly temporary rigging; without a record linking unit IDs to glass specifications at handover, replacements arrive with the wrong coating or size, bringing colour mismatch and leaks.
units.misconception: 單元式帷幕牆的玻璃壞了，只要從室內拆下重裝即可，不需要外牆維護設備。~If a unitized pane breaks, it can simply be replaced from inside without any external access equipment.
units.practice: 竣工文件應包含單元編號圖、各單元玻璃與型材規格、錨件與接縫細部、試驗報告、BMU 操作與吊運程序、備品清單與保固條款；任何外牆改裝或加掛招牌前，須由帷幕牆顧問評估對錨件與防水的影響並經業主核准。~Completion documents should include the unit ID map, glass and profile specifications for each unit, bracket and joint details, test reports, BMU operating and lifting procedures, spares list and warranties; before any façade alteration or added signage, the façade consultant must assess the effect on brackets and waterproofing and the owner must approve.

example: 設計練習：某 60 層辦公塔標準層周長 120 m、層高 4.2 m，採 1.5 m 寬單元，標準區設計風壓 3.0 kPa、角隅區 4.5 kPa。每層 120/1.5 = 80 片，共 4,800 片。標準區每單元風力 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN，每錨件 9.45 kN；角隅區為 4.5×1.5×4.2 = 28.35 kN，每錨件約 14.2 kN，乘 1.5 為 21.3 kN。豎框：標準區 w = 4.5 kN/m，L/175 = 24 mm 需 I ≥ 1.09×10⁷ mm⁴；角隅區 w = 6.75 kN/m，需 I 按比例增為約 1.63×10⁷ mm⁴，即增加 50%。接縫變位預算 18.8 mm，設計 ±20 mm；層間位移試驗 1.5×21 = 31.5 mm。公差組合 √(25² + 10² + 5²) ≈ 27.4 mm，在 ±30 mm 調整量內。若安裝速率每日 40 片，約 120 個工作天。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。~Design exercise: a 60-storey office tower has a 120 m typical-floor perimeter and 4.2 m storeys, using 1.5 m units with design pressures of 3.0 kPa in typical zones and 4.5 kPa at corners. Each floor needs 120/1.5 = 80 units, 4,800 in total. A typical unit takes 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN of wind, 9.45 kN per anchor; a corner unit takes 4.5×1.5×4.2 = 28.35 kN, about 14.2 kN per anchor or 21.3 kN with a 1.5 factor. Mullions: in typical zones w = 4.5 kN/m and L/175 = 24 mm requires I ≥ 1.09×10⁷ mm⁴; at corners w = 6.75 kN/m, so I rises proportionally to about 1.63×10⁷ mm⁴, 50% more. The stack-joint movement budget is 18.8 mm, designed as ±20 mm, and the racking test uses 1.5×21 = 31.5 mm. Combined tolerance √(25² + 10² + 5²) ≈ 27.4 mm lies within the ±30 mm adjustment. At 40 units per day installation takes about 120 working days. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
history: 單元式帷幕牆把立面的玻璃、框料與密封移到工廠組裝，隨著超高層建築的興起成為主流做法，因為它減少高空作業、縮短工期並讓品質在可控環境下完成。2010 年完工的哈里發塔高 828 m，官方資料記錄其鋁與玻璃立面在 512 m 高度安裝的紀錄；2014 年完工的紐約世界貿易中心一號大樓由 Benson Industries 承作帷幕牆；倫敦碎片大廈則以約 11,000 片玻璃覆蓋 95 層的錐形塔身。歐洲以 EN 13830 規範帷幕牆產品性能，英國 CWCT 與美國 AAMA 則建立了樣品牆試驗與層間位移試驗的方法。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Unitized curtain walls move glazing, framing and sealing into the factory, and they became the dominant approach as supertall buildings multiplied because they reduce work at height, shorten programmes and let quality be achieved in controlled conditions. Burj Khalifa, completed in 2010 at 828 m, records in its official information the installation of its aluminium and glass façade at a height of 512 m; One World Trade Center in New York, completed in 2014, had its curtain wall delivered by Benson Industries; and The Shard in London covers its 95-storey tapering form with about 11,000 glass panels. In Europe EN 13830 governs curtain-wall product performance, while CWCT in the UK and AAMA in the US established methods for mock-up and racking tests. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
